evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-20"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-20". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date has no time part.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2026-05-05"} set the date (200). PATCH {"title":...} alone left the date unchanged. PATCH {"dueDate":null} cleared it (dueDate null, 200).
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate 2026-02-30, 21.10.2026, foo, 2026-10-21T10:00:00 and 20261021 each returned 400 with an error message. dueDate 123 (a number) also returned 400. PATCH with 2026-02-30 returned 400.
evidence.AC4: I created todos with due dates 2026-10-20 (past), 2026-10-21 (today) and 2027-01-01 (future), one with no due date, and one past-due todo that I then marked done. Today in UTC is 2026-10-21. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the past-due, not-done todo (id 1). Today's todo, the future todo, the todo without a date and the done todo were all excluded.
evidence.AC5: The page at / showed the due date next to each todo that has one (2026-10-20, 2026-10-21, 2027-01-01, 2026-01-01). The todo without a date showed none.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot, only the todo "past" (due 2026-10-20, not done) carried the word "überfällig". Today's todo, the future todo, the todo without a date and the done past-due todo had no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only the "past" todo.
